answer: Home pickup isn't available in Texas, so you'd need to book your appraisal appointment at a store instead. Bring a physical photo ID for every owner on the title (mobile IDs are accepted only in Virginia), the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and the odometer disclosure statement, form NW-ODO-2. Since you lease the car, also bring your dealer payoff quote, and plan for about an hour. The help center articles here don't include the full details on selling a leased car, so please contact a store if you have other questions about your lease.
